assertions.description: Output follows D.R.P.I.V methodology (Discover, Research, Plan, Implement, Validate)
Output enforces the HARD GATE — no code before design approval
Output does NOT jump to implementation without a plan
Output proposes multiple approaches with trade-offs
Output references structured research with confidence scoring or named research tools
Output asks clarifying questions or explicitly requests user approval before proceeding
Output length is under 700 words for focused responses
Output references sprint contracts or acceptance criteria when planning L4+ features
assertions.check: contains_one_of: ["sprint contract", "Sprint Contract", "contract", "acceptance criteria", "Acceptance Criteria", "done definition", "deliverables"]

assertions.description: Output separates planning from evaluation (GEL pattern) — references evaluator, review, or adversarial check
Output references context management or artifact handoffs for long planning sessions
Output does NOT contain implementation code blocks in the planning response itself
Output references the 3-agent GAN harness (Planner + Generator + Evaluator as distinct roles)
assertions.check: contains_one_of: ["GAN harness", "3-agent", "three-agent", "Generator", "generator", "Planner", "planner", "WHAT not HOW", "WHAT, not HOW"]

assertions.description: Output references evaluator calibration — skeptical behavior, few-shot examples, or specific failure criteria
Output references model-aware context management (Sonnet vs Opus or context anxiety)
